description: This file defines a Java interface named LoanCollateralManagementWritePlatformService, which provides a contract for services related to managing loan collateral, specifically including a method to delete loan collateral.

classes.name: LoanCollateralManagementWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface that declares a method for deleting loan collateral given a JsonCommand, part of the collateral management service in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: deleteLoanCollateral
methods.description: Deletes loan collateral based on the provided JsonCommand. Returns a CommandProcessingResult indicating the outcome.
